title: Create: weaponized
description: Create with tacz and other qol mods
body:
Create: weaponized is a modpack with 2 main things create and TaCZ, you can play single player or join our server its up to you. This modpack also contains mods like Biomes O, Plenty
and other helpful mods, Create has a large amount of addons, yet still runs at about 100 fps. 
create or shoot your way through Minecraft with Create: weaponized.
